Name: Treat Your Spouse - Spend Money on Your Spouse
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages:[/b] English（English descriptions are below）, 简体中文

[b][size=5]Treat Your Spouse 给伴侣花钱[/size][/b]

经常有人提问： 星露谷后期赚了那么多钱花不完， 为什么没有“给伴侣花钱“的mod？，于是我自己做了一个

[b]使用方法[/b]：玩家靠近自己的 NPC 伴侣后，[b]按快捷键（默认为k）[/b]打开金额选项，选择后扣除相应金额、增加一点好感度。
选择自动花钱选项后，伴侣每天早上有一定概率主动花一笔钱，扣除金额。
第二天，你会得到伴侣的反馈，并有概率得到一份回礼。

NPC 收到不同金额时会有专属对话，包括原版 12 位可结婚对象和科罗布斯。（ [b]特别感谢小红书网友提供的灵感！[/b] ） 其他配偶/室友会使用默认对话。

（2.3.0新增）可在给钱菜单里查看当前伴侣的账本，查看累计消费金额，以及最常买的东西
（2.4.0新增）伴侣的购买物品能真实在背包中看到！（ 目前素材有限，仅支持部分 NPC 的购买物品。 ）
（2.5.0新增）增加与[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47777]伴侣共享冰箱[/url] mod 联动内容。伴侣将会购买爱吃食物放进冰箱，也会把食物类回礼放进冰箱。
（2.6.0新增）为塞巴斯蒂安、海莉、潘妮、阿比盖尔和亚历克斯新增专属剧情事件。其他伴侣的专属事件将在后续版本中陆续加入。

[b]金额档位和回礼（2.0.0）：[/b]
[spoiler][b]小额[/b]：增加15点好感度。可能回礼： 香蕉、草莓、面包、煎蛋、薄煎饼、玉米饼、鳟鱼汤、沙拉、意大利面、咖啡、粘土 ×5。
[b]中等[/b]： 增加30点好感度。可能回礼： 披萨、香辣鳗鱼、幸运午餐、南瓜汤、完美早餐、蟹黄糕、三倍浓缩咖啡、杨桃、菠萝、高级生长激素 ×5、高级保湿土壤 ×5、高级肥料 ×5、谜之盒、煤炭 ×10。
[b]大额[/b]： 增加50点好感度。可能回礼： 铱锭、电池组、兔子的脚、顶级生长激素 ×5、顶级保湿土壤 ×5、顶级肥料 ×5、宝石甜莓、上古水果、鱼子酱、松露油、金色谜之盒 ×2。[/spoiler]
送钱和原版游戏给伴侣送礼机制不同，不会占用原本每日送礼的次数。

[b]特殊事件触发条件（2.6.0）：[/b]
[spoiler]共同条件：
[list]
[*]对该伴侣的累计支持金额至少达到 50,000g。[/*]
[*]对该伴侣的成功花钱次数至少达到 10 次。[/*]
[*]满足以上金额和次数条件后，再等待 7 天。[/*]
[/list]塞巴斯蒂安：游戏发布成功

[*]触发时间：12:00–22:00。[/*]
[/list]潘妮：新书与文具
[list]

[*]天气要求：晴天。[/*]
[/list]阿比盖尔：抵达矿井底层

[/list][/spoiler]

[b]配置项[/b]
支持通过 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 配置：
[list]
[*]快捷键 [/*]
[*]三档金额 [/*]
[*]回礼概率 [/*]
[*]触发距离（ 即按下快捷键时，玩家与伴侣之间允许触发互动的最远距离。）[/*]
[*]每日自动花钱概率[/*]
[*]单次自动花钱金额上限、下限[/*]
[*]自动花钱最低保留金额（如果存款余额低于这个数值就不会花钱了）[/*]
[*]购买物品进入背包（开启后，伴侣购买的物品能够真的出现在玩家的背包。目前素材有限，仅支持部分 NPC 的少量购买物品。）[/*]
[/list]
[b]兼容性[/b]
已兼容多婚mod（已测试 PolyamorySweet。精力有限，其他同类mod暂无逐一测试。）
已支持联机使用。 需要每位参与联机的玩家都安装本mod。目前仅支持对NPC伴侣使用，不能对另一位联机玩家使用。
2.3.2版本后兼容安卓版，需要下载虚拟键盘mod。 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29884]VirtualKeyboard at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]

[size=4]English:[/size]
Have you ever wished you could spend a little money on your spouse after marriage?

[b]How to use:[/b] Stand near your NPC spouse, [b]press a hotkey[/b] (K by default), and choose how much you want to spend on them. 
Each vanilla spouse, as well as Krobus, has custom reactions based on the amount. Custom NPC spouses are also supported and will use generic dialogue.

After enabling the auto-spending option, your spouse will have a chance to spend some money each morning. The next day, they will tell you what they bought and may also give you a return gift.

(New in 2.3.0) You can now view your spouse's ledger from the giving-money menu, including their total spending and most frequently purchased items.
(New in 2.4.0) Some of the items purchased by your spouse can now actually appear in your inventory! Due to limited art assets, this feature currently supports only some purchased items for certain NPCs.
(New in 2.5.0) Added integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47777]Shared Fridge With Spouse[/url]. Your spouse may buy their loved foods and place them in the fridge. Food-type return gifts will also be placed in the fridge.
(New in 2.6.0) Added unique story events for Sebastian, Haley, Penny, Abigail, and Alex. Events for the remaining spouses will be added in future updates.

[b]Possible Return Gifts (Version 2.0.0)[/b]
[spoiler][b]Small Amount[/b]
Increases friendship by 15 points.
Possible return gifts: Banana, Strawberry, Bread, Fried Egg, Pancakes, Tortilla, Trout Soup, Salad, Spaghetti, Coffee, Clay ×5.

[b]Medium Amount[/b]
Increases friendship by 30 points.
Possible return gifts: Pizza, Spicy Eel, Lucky Lunch, Pumpkin Soup, Complete Breakfast, Crab Cakes, Triple Shot Espresso, Starfruit, Pineapple, Deluxe Speed-Gro ×5, Quality Retaining Soil ×5, Quality Fertilizer ×5, Mystery Box, Coal ×10.

[b]Large Amount[/b]
Increases friendship by 50 points.
Possible return gifts: Iridium Bar, Battery Pack, Rabbit's Foot, Hyper Speed-Gro ×5, Deluxe Retaining Soil ×5, Deluxe Fertilizer ×5, Sweet Gem Berry, Ancient Fruit, Caviar, Truffle Oil, Golden Mystery Box ×2.[/spoiler]
Giving money is NOT treated as a vanilla Stardew Valley gift. It does not count toward the daily gift limit and does not use the vanilla gift preference system.

[b]Configuration[/b]
This mod supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
You can configure:
[list]
[*]Hotkey[/*]
[*]Three spending amount tiers
(the maximum distance allowed between the player and their spouse when pressing the hotkey)[/*]
[*]Return gift chance[/*]
[*]Trigger distance[/*]
[*]Daily auto-spending chance[/*]
[*]Minimum and maximum amount for each auto-spending event[/*]
[*]Minimum balance to keep for auto-spending
(auto-spending will not happen if your current money is below this amount)[/*]
[*]Put spouse purchase items in backpack
When enabled, items your spouse buys can actually appear in the player's inventory. Due to limited assets, only a small number of purchased items are currently supported for some NPCs.[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
This mod has been tested with PolyamorySweet and supports multiplayer, as long as every participating player has the mod installed. It only works with NPC spouses and cannot be used to give money to another multiplayer player.
Android compatibility is supported in version 2.3.2 and later. A virtual keyboard mod is required.  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29884]VirtualKeyboard at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]
